criteria.name: Class Structure
criteria.description: Proper class definition with encapsulation (private data, public methods)

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: Private member variables, public getters/setters, proper constructor(s), encapsulation followed correctly

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good structure with minor encapsulation issues

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Class exists but significant encapsulation violations (public data members)

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Attempts class but mostly incorrect structure

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No class or uses struct with no methods

criteria.name: Method Implementation
criteria.description: Required methods work correctly (area, perimeter, setters with validation)

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: Area and perimeter calculate correctly, setters validate positive values, all methods work

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Methods work but missing validation or minor calculation errors

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Some methods work, others have bugs or are missing

criteria.name: Input Validation
criteria.description: Validates that width and height are positive values

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: Rejects or handles negative/zero values in constructor and setters

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Validates in some places but not all

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Attempts validation but implementation is flawed

criteria.name: Code Quality
criteria.description: Clean code with good naming, formatting, and documentation

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Descriptive names, consistent formatting, header comments, inline comments for complex logic

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Readable but inconsistent style or minimal documentation

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: Hard to read, poor naming, no comments

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: Unreadable or no effort at code quality
